units.source_text: 这天晚上十二点过后，丈夫依然没下班回家。

en.t: After midnight that night, her husband still had not come home from work.

units.source_text: 信子等到深夜，丈夫才带着一身酒气踉跄的进门，醉的自己都脱不了自己的雨衣。

en.t: Nobuko waited until late at night before her husband finally staggered in reeking of alcohol, so drunk that he could not even take off his own raincoat.

units.source_text: 信子眉头蹙了起来，利落的照顾丈夫，帮他脱下衣服。

en.t: Nobuko frowned, then efficiently took care of her husband and helped him undress.

units.source_text: 虽然这样殷勤，但丈夫依然口齿不清的嘲讽：“今晚我晚回来，你的小说应该可以写的更快吧。”

en.t: Even though she was so attentive, her husband still mocked her in a slurred voice: "Since I came home late tonight, you should be able to write your novel faster, shouldn't you?"

units.source_text: 他像个唠叨的女人一般，反反复复说着类似的话。

en.t: He repeated such remarks over and over, like a nagging woman.

units.source_text: 晚上，信子躺在床上，泪流满面。

en.t: That night, Nobuko lay in bed with tears streaming down her face.

units.source_text: 假如照子看到自己的这般光景，必定会和自己一起哭吧。

en.t: If Teruko saw me in such a state, she would surely cry with me.

units.source_text: 照子，照子妹妹，我只能依靠你了。

en.t: Teruko, my dear sister Teruko, you are the only one I can rely on now.

units.source_text: 信子在心中反复思念自己的妹妹照子，在丈夫酒气熏天的床上，辗转反侧，一夜未眠。

en.t: In her heart, Nobuko thought again and again of her younger sister Teruko; in the bed reeking of her husband's alcohol, she tossed and turned and did not sleep all night.
